If you have questions about this policy or wish to exercise your data protection rights, please contact us using the details above.

* Information voluntarily submitted through website forms
When you make a purchase, we may process:
Payments may be handled by third-party payment processors.
We do not require customers to provide full payment card numbers or card security codes through email or customer support messages.
When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, including:
* Approximate location derived from technical information
The information collected depends on the technologies and services used by our website.
We process personal information for legitimate business purposes and other purposes permitted by law.
Order Processing: Processing purchases, confirming orders, and maintaining transaction records.
Delivery & Fulfilment: Arranging shipment, providing tracking information, and communicating delivery updates.
Customer Support: Responding to enquiries, resolving complaints, and assisting with product-related issues.
Returns & Refunds: Processing return requests, exchanges, cancellations, and refunds.
Website Operation: Maintaining website functionality, security, and performance.
Fraud Prevention: Detecting potentially unauthorised transactions and protecting customers and our business.
Legal Compliance: Meeting applicable accounting, tax, consumer protection, and regulatory obligations.
Marketing: Sending promotional communications where permitted by law and subject to applicable consent or opt-out requirements.
Under the UK GDPR, we must have a valid lawful basis for processing personal data.
Depending on the circumstances, we may rely on the following bases:
Performance of a contract or legal obligation
Preventing fraud and securing our website
Consent or legitimate interests, where legally permitted
Where we rely on legitimate interests, we consider the relevant business purpose and the rights and freedoms of individuals.
Where consent is required, you may withdraw it at any time.
Payments made through our website are processed using the payment services available at checkout.
Payment processors may collect and process information necessary to authorise and complete transactions.
Depending on the payment method, this may include billing information, payment credentials, transaction references, and fraud-prevention data.
Payment processors may act as independent controllers or processors, depending on their services and applicable terms.
We encourage customers to review the privacy information provided by their selected payment provider.
We do not ask customers to disclose full card details, security codes, or banking passwords through email.
We may share personal information with third parties where reasonably necessary to operate our business, fulfil orders, or comply with legal obligations.
* Analytics and marketing providers, where applicable
We aim to limit information sharing to what is reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.
Where third parties process personal data on our behalf, we aim to use appropriate contractual and security safeguards.
We do not sell personal information in the ordinary commercial sense of selling customer databases.
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support website functionality and improve the browsing experience.
Essential Cookies: Required for core website functions such as shopping baskets, checkout, security, and session management.
Preference Cookies: Used to remember selected website preferences.
Analytics Cookies: Used to understand website traffic and usage patterns, where enabled.
Marketing Cookies: Used for advertising measurement or relevant marketing activities, where enabled.
Non-essential cookies and similar technologies will be used only where permitted under applicable UK privacy and electronic communications requirements, including obtaining consent where required.
You can manage relevant cookie preferences through the controls made available on our website.
For more information, please review our Cookie Policy.
We may send promotional emails or other marketing communications where permitted by applicable law.
Where consent is required, we will seek it before sending marketing communications.
In certain circumstances, UK law permits marketing to existing customers under the applicable soft opt-in conditions.
You can opt out of marketing communications at any time by:
* Using the unsubscribe option in a marketing email, where provided.
Opting out of marketing will not prevent us from sending essential order confirmations, delivery updates, or other necessary service communications.
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including applicable legal, accounting, tax, and contractual requirements.
Retention periods depend on the type of information and the relevant purpose.
* Order and transaction records: Retained for applicable accounting, tax, and legal requirements.
* Customer support records: Retained as reasonably necessary to manage enquiries and disputes.
* Account information: Retained while an account remains active and for any additional period justified by legal or operational requirements.
* Marketing preferences: Retained as necessary to manage subscriptions and opt-outs.
* Technical logs: Retained for appropriate security and operational purposes.
We will review and delete or anonymise personal information when it is no longer required, subject to applicable legal obligations.
Some service providers used to operate our website may process or store personal information outside the United Kingdom.
Where international transfers occur, we aim to ensure that appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable UK data protection law.
* The UK International Data Transfer Agreement
* The UK Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses
The safeguards used depend on the relevant provider and transfer arrangements.
We take reasonable technical and organisational measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorised access, accidental loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
Depending on the systems involved, measures may include:
No internet-based system can guarantee absolute security.
If you believe your information has been compromised, please contact us promptly.
Under the UK GDPR, you may have the following rights, subject to applicable conditions and exemptions:
Right of Access: Request a copy of personal data we hold about you.
Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Right to Erasure: Request deletion of personal data in certain circumstances.
Right to Restrict Processing: Request restrictions on certain uses of your personal data.
Right to Data Portability: Receive certain personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format where the legal conditions apply.
Right to Object: Object to certain processing activities, including direct marketing.
Rights Relating to Automated Decision-Making: Receive applicable protections concerning qualifying solely automated decisions.
Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent where consent is the lawful basis for processing.
We may request reasonable information to verify your identity before responding.
We will generally respond within one month, subject to lawful extensions or exceptions.
Our website is intended for general retail customers and is not specifically directed at children.
We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children for independent purchasing or marketing purposes.
If you believe a child has provided personal information inappropriately, please contact us so we can review the matter.
Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including payment providers, manufacturers, or delivery services.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices of independently operated third-party websites.
We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before providing personal information.
We may use automated systems or payment-provider checks to help identify potentially fraudulent or unauthorised transactions.
These checks may involve transaction information, technical identifiers, and payment-related risk indicators.
Where automated processing gives rise to rights under applicable data protection law, we will respect those rights.
If you believe a decision concerning your order has been made incorrectly, please contact our customer support team.
If you have concerns about how your personal information is handled, please contact us first so we can investigate.
You also have the right to complain to the UK's data protection supervisory authority:
You do not have to contact us before making a complaint to the ICO.
We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our website, business operations, data processing practices, or applicable legal requirements.
Any changes will be published on this page with an updated revision date.
Where required by law, we will provide additional notice or seek consent before implementing relevant changes.
For questions about this Privacy Policy, requests concerning your personal information, or privacy-related complaints, please contact:
Operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD

Cookies are small text files that websites may store on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit them.
Cookies can help websites remember information about your visit, maintain sessions, and provide certain features.
For example, cookies may help a shopping website:
* Remember products added to a basket.
* Preserve checkout information during a visit.
* Understand website usage, where analytics are enabled.
* Support advertising measurement, where applicable and permitted.
Cookies do not necessarily identify you directly, but some cookies and related identifiers may constitute personal data under applicable law.
Our website may use the following categories of cookies, depending on the features and services enabled.
Strictly necessary cookies support essential website functions.
These cookies may be used without consent where they meet the applicable legal exemption.
Disabling them may prevent certain parts of the website from functioning correctly.
Functional cookies may remember settings or preferences that improve your browsing experience.
Where a functional cookie is not strictly necessary for a service you have requested, we will obtain consent where required by law.
Analytics cookies may help us understand how visitors use our website.
Depending on the analytics tools enabled, information may include:
We may use this information to identify technical problems and improve the shopping experience.
Where consent is required, analytics cookies will not be activated before you provide that consent.
If advertising or marketing technologies are enabled, cookies or similar identifiers may be used to:
These technologies may involve third-party advertising providers.
We will seek consent before using non-essential advertising cookies where required by applicable law.
We do not claim that any particular advertising platform is active unless it is actually implemented on our website.
First-party cookies are set by the website you are visiting.
They may be used to support essential functions such as shopping baskets, customer sessions, and preferences.
Third-party cookies may be set by external services integrated into our website.
Depending on the technologies used, these services may include:
Third parties may process information under their own privacy and cookie policies.
We aim to provide appropriate information about non-essential third-party technologies and obtain consent where required.
Cookies can also be classified according to how long they remain on your device.
Session Cookies: These are generally temporary and expire when your browser session ends.
Persistent Cookies: These remain on your device for a defined period or until you delete them.
Cookie duration depends on the specific cookie and its purpose.
Where applicable, the cookie preference interface or detailed cookie information provided on our website should identify relevant retention periods.
Cookies and similar technologies may be used for the following purposes:
Maintaining information needed to complete an order
Protecting sessions and detecting suspicious activity
Understanding website usage, where enabled and consented to
Measuring advertising activities, where enabled and consented to
The specific technologies used depend on the configuration of our website.

Under applicable UK privacy legislation, including the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR), consent is generally required before storing or accessing information on a user's device unless a relevant exemption applies.
Where required, we will seek your consent before enabling non-essential cookies.
Our intended cookie consent approach is to:
* Explain the categories of cookies used.
* Allow visitors to accept or reject non-essential cookies.
* Avoid treating silence or continued browsing as consent.
* Provide a way to change or withdraw consent.
* Prevent non-essential cookies from being activated before valid consent is obtained.
Consent must be freely given, specific, informed, and indicated through an appropriate affirmative action.
Strictly necessary cookies may remain active where a legal exemption applies.
You can manage cookies through the privacy controls available on our website, where implemented.
You may also manage cookies through your browser settings.

Please note that blocking strictly necessary cookies may affect shopping basket functionality, account access, or checkout.
Changing your browser settings does not necessarily withdraw consent for all other tracking technologies, so we also aim to provide suitable website-level privacy controls.
You can find cookie management instructions through your browser provider.
Browser settings and available controls may change over time.
Certain cookies or similar technologies may be necessary to support the checkout process.
* Associate checkout activity with your session.

Where such technologies are not covered by an applicable exemption, consent requirements will be considered.
For more information about payments, please review our Payment Methods Policy.

Depending on the technology, information may include:
For more information about how personal data is processed and your rights, please review our Privacy Policy.
Some third-party service providers may process cookie-related information outside the United Kingdom.
Where personal data is transferred internationally, we aim to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable UK data protection law.
These may include UK adequacy regulations or other legally recognised transfer mechanisms.
The applicable safeguards depend on the services used.
Cookie retention periods depend on their purpose and the relevant service.
Some cookies expire when your browser session ends, while others may remain for a specified period.
We aim to avoid retaining cookie-related information longer than necessary for its intended purpose.

We are committed to improving the accessibility and usability of our website, https://thehandlefactory.uk, for all visitors, including people with disabilities and those using assistive technologies.

lines: At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we believe that everyone should be able to access information, browse products, and shop online with dignity, independence, and ease.
We are committed to improving the accessibility and usability of our website, https://thehandlefactory.uk, for all visitors, including people with disabilities and those using assistive technologies.
This Accessibility Statement explains our accessibility goals, the standards we aim to follow, how customers can request assistance, and how to report accessibility barriers.
We aim to provide an inclusive online shopping experience that allows customers to:
* Review shipping, returns, and refund policies.
We recognise that accessibility is an ongoing process and that improvements may be necessary as our website develops.
We aim to align our website with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
These guidelines are based on four principles:
Perceivable: Information and interface elements should be presented in ways users can perceive.
Operable: Navigation and interactive features should be usable through different input methods.
Understandable: Information and website functionality should be clear and predictable.
Robust: Website content should work with a range of browsers, devices, and assistive technologies.
WCAG 2.2 Level AA is our accessibility target. This statement does not represent a claim that the entire website has been independently audited or certified as fully compliant.
We aim to incorporate accessibility considerations into the design and maintenance of our website.
We aim to make essential website functions accessible using a keyboard without requiring a mouse.
This includes navigation menus, product links, forms, and checkout controls.
We aim to organise our website using understandable headings, menus, and page structures.
We aim to use readable typography, appropriate spacing, and sufficient colour contrast.
We aim to provide meaningful alternative text for informative product images and other relevant visual content.
We aim to provide clear labels, instructions, and error messages for forms, including contact and checkout forms.
We aim to support customers using desktop computers, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices.
We aim to improve compatibility with screen readers, keyboard navigation, browser zoom, and other assistive technologies.
The availability and effectiveness of these features may vary across individual pages and third-party integrations.
The Handle Factory offers products across the following categories:
We aim to present product names, descriptions, specifications, prices, and relevant purchasing information clearly.
If you experience difficulty accessing product information, please contact our customer support team.
We can assist with product enquiries and provide available information in an alternative accessible format where reasonably practicable.
We recognise that checkout accessibility is particularly important for online shopping.
We aim to make the purchasing process understandable and usable, including:

If you encounter an accessibility barrier during checkout, please contact us so we can investigate the issue and discuss available assistance.
We aim to make customer support accessible to people with different communication needs.
You can contact us using the following methods:
If you require assistance with a product enquiry, order, return, refund, or website feature, please explain your accessibility needs when contacting us.
We will consider reasonable ways to assist you.
Although we aim to improve accessibility, some parts of our website may not yet fully meet our target standards.
* Product images with incomplete alternative descriptions
* Interactive elements requiring further keyboard optimisation
* External services linked from our website
These are areas that may require review, rather than confirmed findings from a completed accessibility audit.
We encourage customers to report any difficulties they experience.
Our website may include functionality provided by third parties, such as:
We may not have full control over the accessibility of third-party websites or services.
However, we aim to consider accessibility when selecting and reviewing integrations.
If you experience difficulties with a third-party feature used during your shopping experience, please contact us.
If you encounter an accessibility issue on our website, we encourage you to let us know.
* The webpage address where the problem occurred
* A description of the accessibility barrier
* The device or browser you were using
* Any assistive technology involved, if you wish to share this information
* The assistance or alternative format you require
You do not need to disclose a medical condition or disability diagnosis to request accessibility assistance.
We will review your enquiry and work towards an appropriate response.
10. Requesting Information in an Accessible Format
If you cannot access information on our website, you may request assistance or an alternative format.
Depending on the information and available resources, we may be able to provide:
Please contact info@thehandlefactory.uk and explain the information you need.
We will consider reasonable requests and communicate available options.
We recognise that accessibility requires ongoing attention.
As our website develops, we aim to:
* Review accessibility concerns raised by customers.
* Improve form labels and error messages.
* Review text readability and colour contrast.
* Improve alternative descriptions for meaningful images.
* Consider accessibility when introducing new features.
We do not claim that all these improvements have already been completed.
We aim to consider applicable UK equality and accessibility requirements, including the Equality Act 2010, where relevant.
We recognise the importance of reasonable adjustments and fair access to goods and services.
We also use recognised accessibility guidance, including WCAG, to inform our website accessibility goals.
This statement does not constitute a formal accessibility certification or a declaration of full compliance with every technical criterion.
We welcome feedback about the accessibility and usability of our website.
If you are dissatisfied with how an accessibility concern has been handled, please contact us again with the details of your complaint.
We will review the matter and consider appropriate next steps.
Nothing in this statement limits any legal rights or remedies available under applicable law.

lines: At The Handle Factory, operated by THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD, we believe that customers should have clear information and meaningful choices about how their personal data is collected, used, and managed.

This page explains your privacy options, including how to manage cookies, control marketing communications, access or correct your personal information, request deletion of eligible data, and exercise your rights under United Kingdom data protection law.

We aim to process personal information in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, and applicable provisions of the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR).
Legal Business Name: THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD
THE HANDLE FACTORY LTD is generally the data controller for personal information processed in connection with our online retail activities.
For privacy enquiries or requests concerning your personal information, please contact us using the details above.
Depending on the circumstances and applicable legal requirements, you may have the following rights:
* Right of Access: Request information about the personal data we hold about you and obtain a copy.
* Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
* Right to Erasure: Request deletion of personal information where the legal conditions apply.
* Right to Restrict Processing: Request that certain processing activities be restricted.
* Right to Data Portability: Receive certain personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
* Right to Object: Object to certain processing activities, including direct marketing.
* Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent for processing activities that rely on your consent.
* Rights Relating to Automated Decision-Making: Exercise applicable rights concerning qualifying solely automated decisions.
These rights are subject to legal conditions and exemptions. Not every right applies to every processing activity.
Cookies and similar technologies may be used to support website functionality and, where enabled, analytics, personalisation, or marketing.
You may be able to manage the following categories through our website's cookie preference controls:
Shopping basket, checkout, security, and essential website functionality
Generally active where legally exempt from consent
Accept or reject where consent is required
Understanding website performance and visitor activity
Where consent is required, non-essential cookies must not be activated before valid consent has been obtained.
You may withdraw your consent at any time through the available cookie preference controls or by contacting us.
You can also delete or block cookies through your browser settings.
For more information, please review our Cookie Policy.
We may send marketing communications about products, promotions, or updates where permitted by applicable law.
You can opt out of direct marketing at any time.
* Use the unsubscribe link included in a marketing email, where available.
* Contact info@thehandlefactory.uk and request removal from marketing communications.
We will respect valid opt-out requests.
You may still receive necessary transactional communications, including order confirmations, delivery updates, payment notifications, and customer support messages.
5. Request Access to Your Personal Data
You may request confirmation of whether we process your personal data and, where applicable, obtain access to that information.
Suggested Subject: Personal Data Access Request
Please include sufficient information to help us identify the relevant records.
We may request reasonable identity verification where necessary.
We will generally respond within one month, subject to any lawful extension.
If your personal information is inaccurate or incomplete, you may request a correction.
To request a correction, contact info@thehandlefactory.uk.
If your request concerns an active order, please contact us promptly because delivery details may become difficult to change once an order has been dispatched.
7. Request Deletion of Your Personal Data
You may request deletion of your personal information where the legal requirements for erasure are met.
For example, deletion may be appropriate where:
* Personal information is no longer necessary for its original purpose.
* You withdraw consent and no other lawful basis applies.
* You successfully object to certain processing.
* Personal information has been processed unlawfully.
However, some information may need to be retained for legal, tax, accounting, contractual, or dispute-resolution purposes.
For example, we may need to retain certain transaction records even after a customer requests account deletion.
Suggested Subject: Personal Data Deletion Request
We will review the request and explain any applicable restrictions or retention requirements.
You may object to processing based on legitimate interests, subject to the applicable legal conditions.
You also have the right to object to processing of your personal data for direct marketing purposes.
Where you object to direct marketing, we will stop processing your personal data for that purpose.
Please describe the processing activity you wish to object to.
9. Restrict the Processing of Your Information
You may request that we restrict certain uses of your personal information where the legal conditions apply.
For example, this may be relevant where:
* You contest the accuracy of personal information.
* Processing is unlawful and you request restriction instead of deletion.
* We no longer need the data, but you require it for legal claims.
* You have objected to processing and the relevant assessment is pending.
We will review requests in accordance with applicable data protection law.
In certain circumstances, you may request personal information you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
This right generally applies where the relevant processing is automated and based on consent or contractual necessity.
Where technically feasible and legally required, you may also request transmission to another controller.
Where we rely on consent to process personal information, you may withdraw that consent at any time.
Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before consent was withdrawn.
It also does not necessarily prevent processing that is required under another valid lawful basis.
When you purchase products from The Handle Factory, certain information is necessary to process and fulfil your order.
Payments are handled through the payment services available during checkout.
We do not ask customers to send full payment card numbers, card security codes, or online banking passwords through email.
Some transaction information must be retained to comply with legal and accounting obligations.
For more information, please review our Privacy Policy and Payment Methods Policy.
Our website may use third-party providers for services such as:
Some third parties may act as independent data controllers and operate under their own privacy policies.
Where third parties process personal information on our behalf, we aim to use appropriate contractual and security safeguards.
If you wish to exercise rights concerning information held independently by a third party, you may also need to contact that provider.
Some service providers may process personal information outside the United Kingdom.
Where such transfers occur, we aim to use appropriate safeguards in accordance with applicable UK data protection requirements.
These may include adequacy regulations or legally recognised contractual transfer mechanisms.
You may contact us for further information about relevant international transfer safeguards.
Payment and security providers may use automated checks to identify suspicious or potentially unauthorised transactions.
Where processing involves qualifying solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects, applicable UK GDPR protections will be respected.
If you have concerns about a decision affecting your purchase, please contact our customer support team.

We will generally respond to valid UK GDPR rights requests within one month.
In certain circumstances, the response period may be extended by up to two additional months where permitted by law, taking account of the complexity and number of requests.
If an extension is necessary, we will inform you within the initial response period and explain the reason.
Requests are generally handled free of charge, although the law permits a reasonable fee or refusal in certain circumstances, such as manifestly unfounded or excessive requests.
If you have concerns about how we collect, use, or manage your personal information, please contact us.
